scenarios.name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request received at /Glovia_SalesOrder with standard Sales Order notification payload matching route condition Glovia_Route_SalesOrder
scenarios.expected_outcome: HTTP 202/200 OK accepted, headers (Region, Country, TimeStamp, BusinessObject, Sender) enriched, routed via SequenceFlow_82 to Message Mapping 1, headers logged via Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and successfully finalized at EndEvent_2
scenarios.validates: CallActivity_4 (Property & Header Enricher), ExclusiveGateway_80 routing condition Glovia_Route_SalesOrder, CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Header logging), and EndEvent_2

scenarios.name: Sales Order Return Route Processing
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request with order type indicating return, satisfying condition Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routed through SequenceFlow_113, executes CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy), sets custom header properties for tracking, and reaches EndEvent_9 without invoking sales order mapping
scenarios.validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 condition Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder, CallActivity_71 script execution, and EndEvent_9 completion

scenarios.name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation Default Route
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request with unrecognized OrderTypeCode not matching either SalesOrder or ReturnSalesOrder route expressions
scenarios.expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110, triggering EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 with error code 'RoutingConditionNotMet'
scenarios.validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path branch and EndEvent_11 EscalationEndEvent handling

scenarios.name: Mapping Failure and Exception Subprocess Activation
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP request matching SalesOrder route with schema-incompatible XML content causing runtime mapping exception in CallActivity_102
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exception SubProcess_91 catches error via StartEvent_92, restores original message via CallActivity_97 (${property.InputPayload}), logs attachment via CallActivity_100 (Log_Payload.gsh), and terminates via Error EndEvent_95
scenarios.validates: SubProcess_91 execution, CallActivity_97 property extraction, CallActivity_100 attachment logging, and EndEvent_95 error propagation

scenarios.name: Malformed Inbound XML Payload at SOAP Adapter
scenarios.trigger: Malformed XML structure (unclosed tags, invalid syntax) received at /Glovia_SalesOrder
scenarios.expected_outcome: SOAP adapter rejects payload before enrichment with HTTP 400 or triggers StartEvent_92 exception subprocess if parsed inside the flow
scenarios.validates: SOAP sender adapter validation and boundary handling for corrupt inbound XML streams

scenarios.name: Header and Property Boundary Evaluation
scenarios.trigger: Valid SOAP notification payload with missing optional header externalized parameters and unicode order characters
scenarios.expected_outcome: CallActivity_4 creates properties without NullPointerExceptions, retains complete XML payload in InputPayload property, and successfully executes generic header logging
scenarios.validates: CallActivity_4 property table handling and parameter substitution resilience

risks.risk: Message Loss via Escalation End Event without Sender Notification
risks.consequence: The ExclusiveGateway_80 routes non-matching order types to EndEvent_11 (Escalation End) without an alert adapter or dead-letter queue. The sender system (Glovia) will not receive an error callback because returnExceptionToSender is set to false.
risks.mitigation: Unit tests TC_GLOVIA_003 and TC_GLOVIA_005 assert on the Escalation Code RoutingConditionNotMet. Mitigation requires adding an alert notification step or Dead Letter Queue (JMS) write before EndEvent_11.

risks.risk: Unconnected / Floating Groovy Script Logic in Integration Process
risks.consequence: Script CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and Content Modifier CallActivity_86 are defined inside Process_1 but have no incoming or outgoing sequence flows. Valid order codes ('YORB', 'YICB', 'POR', 'MNZ', 'PLM') checked by the script are never evaluated by the active router.
risks.mitigation: Test suite validates routing conditions directly against runtime gateway expressions. The integration architecture must be updated to either wire CallActivity_77 into the sequence flow before ExclusiveGateway_80 or remove obsolete elements.

risks.consequence: If Glovia changes payload fields, Message Mapping CallActivity_102 (Test_Mapping.mmap) fails. Although SubProcess_91 logs the payload via Log_Payload (1).gsh, the message is unretrievable if MPL retention expires.
risks.mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_004 validates that CallActivity_97 reads ${property.InputPayload} and logs it as an attachment, preventing loss of the inbound request body during failure diagnosis.

risks.consequence: ParallelGateway_74 has only a single outgoing branch (SequenceFlow_109) in the BPMN XML, creating an unnecessary multicast overhead and potential race condition if additional asynchronous branches are attached in the future without join semantics.
risks.mitigation: Test cases assert single-threaded sequential path execution from ParallelGateway_74 directly into ExclusiveGateway_80.

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier for OrganizationId) are isolated floating nodes in the BPMN definition with no incoming or outgoing sequence flows. They cannot be executed by the runtime process engine in its current model.
coverage_recommendations: Connect CallActivity_77 directly after CallActivity_4 so the header 'OrderCodeValid' is created and evaluated in ExclusiveGateway_80.
Connect CallActivity_86 before routing to extract OrganizationId from XPath into headers as intended, or delete dangling nodes to eliminate technical debt.
Implement a dedicated Dead Letter Queue queue write in Exception Subprocess 91 to guarantee 100% auditable error delivery.
